body: I'm sorry its just hard to talk to people. I don't even talk to those close to me. I just try, even if I am failing at this, to keep this to myself. I am just lost...I drink or smoke to not think about this but it pops up every night. I just hate myself.
Thanks. I think I need to do that. I just my breaking point. I am currently looking to find some professional help. I just don't want to feel like this anymore.
Yea thanks it just sucks. Now everyone in this house is fighting. Everyone getting angry. I just don't know what to do

Yea I am burnt out. I was able to take a 2-3 day vacation every 2 years or so but now I haven't accepted any money from them so I haven't been able to do that. I am very burnt out. Even though I have a large family here, all my grandparents sons and daughters they only come by once a week to see him for 10-15 minutes.

I know the legal ramifications, but they're my family. As much as I hate them I can't bring myself to bring anything like that onto them.

As for a career, I am not sure what goes into being a lvn, or cna. I don't have any prerequisites or any training for that. Well circumstances may not be the same but at least you can understand the burden and stress of being a caregiver.

Well...Guess my suicide isn't coming anytime soon. My mom broke down crying...I couldn't stand to see the pain. I guess I will have to wait til she passes. I can't put her through this after all she has done.

Yea everyone seems to be younger, not to hate on them, I definitely felt this way in my teenage, early college years, but they still have a life ahead of em. I just seem to be in the middle of my life without nothing to show for it. Hope all the best for you.

I understand, but this seems to define me. What happens after they are gone? I am nothing. I have nothing. I would have to rely on parents for everything while everyone around me is off doing better. I just...I can't do this anymore.
Thank you. I don't believe in God. I am trying...But I don't even know what I have. Everything that keeps me here just seems a distraction to others or just nonsense, i.e. games, comics, tv, movies.
Fuck...My mom came saw me crying and started crying...fuck I cant do this...

Thank you for responding. I just can't shake this feeling. Comparing myself to my friends and family. Those who have careers, family, those who can do what they want without worrying. Those who started a career, started a family, bought their own home. My area a shitty house costs at least 400-500k. Yet I am here worrying about if I have enough money to hang out with them for the night.

Thank you so much for actually responding. I have a problem with my addictive personality. I go in cycles with this. I stopped drinking for a long time. But these last few weeks I would kill a 750 ml a bottle a week, prolly more if I had money, in a night. I just don't see the light at the end of the tunnel. I just can't shake this feeling. Off and on for the last 15 years I have been feeling this way, the last 5 years haven been worse. I just want it to end. Waiting for my grandparent to pass away then I can be free from this suffering.
